value.en: Done: count and remainder both take an input hold; a tick it is 1 does not count.

value.zh: 做成了：格式 flagbyte，校验位前面补 0 凑成一个字节，和内容一起填充；bytes、ends、sent、relayed 都按它解。
value.en: Done: the format flagbyte, its check bits padded with 0s in front to a whole byte and stuffed with the content; bytes, ends, sent and relayed decode it.

why: The written slots brought in line with the revised blueprint: counter, deserializer and CRC take hold; the deserializer says when its byte is done; the CRC gives the check due next; 1-16 reads it; 1-20 asks which bit flipped, after 1-15

brief.zh: 输出自「重来」上一次为 1 起已经过了几拍（那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时，从第一拍数起）；「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，那一拍的数和上一拍相同。
brief.en: Output how many ticks have passed since restart was last 1 (0 on that tick; counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1); ticks on which hold is 1 do not count, and on them the number stays as it was.

t.zh: 要知道一个字节该发到第几位、已经收了几位，板得知道过了几拍；寄存卡只记一个值，手上的元件又都不能让一个数变大。新元件<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>给出两个数之和。
t.en: To know which bit of a byte is due, or how many have come in, a board must know how many ticks have passed; a register holds one value, and nothing in hand makes a number grow. The new part <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref> gives the sum of two numbers.

desc.zh: 自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍：那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时从第一拍数起；「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，数停在原处。
desc.en: How many ticks since restart was last 1: 0 on that tick; counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1; ticks on which hold is 1 do not count, and the number stands still.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，用 8 拍把那一拍输入的字节从最高位起逐位说到线上，之后说 0；最后一位说出的那一拍，「送完」为 1，其余各拍为 0。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1, say the byte input then on the wire bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, then say 0; done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said and 0 on every other.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起（还没为 1 过时从第一拍起），每逢「暂停」为 0 的拍就收进线上的一位，最高位在前；收满 8 位的那一拍，「字节」输出这个字节，「收完」为 1，其余各拍「收完」为 0。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1 (from the first tick, before it ever is), take in the bit on the wire on every tick hold is 0, top bit first; on the tick the eighth is taken, output the byte and make done 1; done is 0 on every other tick.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-7"></level-ref>把一个字节拆成位送出去；线的另一头要把位拼回一个数。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-7"></level-ref> takes a byte apart into bits; the other end of the wire has to put the bits back into a number.

desc.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起（还没为 1 过时从第一拍起），每逢「暂停」为 0 收进一位，最高位在前；收满 8 位的那一拍给出这个字节，「收完」为 1；其余各拍字节是「—」，「收完」为 0。
desc.en: From the tick start is 1 (from the first tick, before it ever is), takes in a bit on every tick hold is 0, top bit first; on the tick the eighth is taken gives the byte with done 1; on every other tick the byte is 「—」 and done 0.

brief.zh: 每一拍输出到这一拍为止收到的位该跟的 3 位校验码：这些位后面补上三个 0、不进位地除以 1011 的余数，写成一个数。「重来」为 1 的那一拍从这一位重新算起；「暂停」为 1 的拍不收这一位。
brief.en: Every tick, output the 3 check bits due after the bits received so far: their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, as a number. On a tick restart is 1, start over from that bit; on a tick hold is 1, leave that bit out.

t.zh: 奇偶校验位只查得出奇数个错位：恰好翻两位时，校验照样相符。更强的校验把一串位当作一个大数，后面补上几个 0，用不进位的除法除以约好的除数（生成式），余数就是要跟在后面的校验码。不进位的除法里，每一步减法都是逐位的异或。
t.en: A parity bit catches only an odd number of flips: with exactly two flipped, it still checks out. A stronger check reads a run of bits as one big number, appends a few 0s and divides it, without carries, by an agreed divisor (the generator); the remainder is the check to send after the bits. In carry-less division, every subtraction is a bitwise XOR.

desc.zh: 到这一拍为止收进的位该跟的 3 位校验码（补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数，0 到 7 的数）；「重来」为 1 的那一拍从这一位重新算起，「暂停」为 1 的拍不收这一位。
desc.en: The 3 check bits due after the bits taken in so far (their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, a number from 0 to 7); on a tick restart is 1 it starts over from that bit, and on a tick hold is 1 it leaves that bit out.

brief.zh: 把交来的字节从第一拍起逐位送出（最高位在前），紧接着送出它的 3 位校验码。
brief.en: Send the byte handed to you bit by bit from the first tick, top bit first, followed at once by its 3 check bits.

brief.zh: 线上从第一拍起接连送来数据块：每块 4 位数据，后面跟 3 位校验码（生成式 1011）；线在每块里最多翻一位。在每块最后一位到达的那一拍，输出这块的第几位翻了（最先到达的是第 1 位，到第 7 位），没有翻就输出 0。
brief.en: Blocks come down the wire back to back from the first tick: 4 data bits each, followed by 3 check bits (generator 1011); the wire flips at most one bit in a block. On the tick each block's last bit arrives, output which of its bits flipped (1 for the first to arrive, up to 7), or 0 if none did.

t.zh: 到目前为止，校验码只用来判断收到的东西是好是坏。这一次每块只有 4 位数据，却带着 3 位校验码。
t.en: So far the check bits have only judged whether something arrived intact. This time each block carries just 4 data bits, and 3 check bits.

brief.zh: 线上从第一拍起接连送来数据块：每块 4 位数据，后面跟 3 位校验码（生成式 1011）；线在每块里最多翻一位。依次输出每块改正后的 4 位数据（写成一个数），早一拍晚一拍不论。
brief.en: Blocks come down the wire back to back from the first tick: 4 data bits each, followed by 3 check bits (generator 1011); the wire flips at most one bit in a block. Output each block's corrected 4 data bits as a number, in order; the tick does not matter.

t.zh: 到目前为止，校验码只用来判断一帧是好是坏。这一次每块只有 4 位数据，却带着 3 位校验码。
t.en: So far the check bits have only judged whether something arrived intact. This time each block carries just 4 data bits, and 3 check bits.

brief.zh: 把交来的字节从第一拍起逐位送出（最高位在前），紧接着送出它的 3 位校验码：让这 11 位不进位地除以 1011 余 0 的那 3 位。
brief.en: Send the byte handed to you bit by bit from the first tick, top bit first, followed at once by its 3 check bits: the three that make the eleven divide by 1011, without carries, leaving 0.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-15"></level-ref>在收的一方算出余数。发送方要在数据后面附上校验码，让整串位的余数为 0，收的一方一除便知是否完好。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-15"></level-ref> works out a remainder at the receiving end. The sender must append check bits that make the remainder of the whole run 0, so that one division tells the receiver whether it is intact.

brief.zh: 每一拍输出到这一拍为止收到的位串不进位地除以 1011 的余数（写成一个数）；「重来」为 1 的那一拍从这一位重新算起。
brief.en: Every tick, output the carry-less remainder of the bits received so far divided by 1011 (as a number); on a tick restart is 1, start over from that bit.

t.zh: 奇偶校验位只查得出奇数个错位：恰好翻两位时，校验照样相符。更强的校验把一串位当作一个大数，用不进位的除法除以约好的除数（生成式），余数就是校验码。不进位的除法里，每一步减法都是逐位的异或。
t.en: A parity bit catches only an odd number of flips: with exactly two flipped, it still checks out. A stronger check reads a run of bits as one big number and divides it, without carries, by an agreed divisor (the generator); the remainder is the check. In carry-less division, every subtraction is a bitwise XOR.

desc.zh: 到这一拍为止收进的位串不进位地除以 1011 的余数（0 到 7 的数）；「重来」为 1 的那一拍从这一位重新算起。
desc.en: The carry-less remainder, by 1011, of the bits taken in so far (a number from 0 to 7); on a tick restart is 1 it starts over from that bit.

brief.zh: 线上从第一拍起接连送来字节，每个字节后面跟一个奇偶校验位（让这 9 位里 1 的个数为偶数），线会翻位。在每个校验位到达的那一拍，「字节」输出收到的字节，「完好」说出校验是否相符；其余各拍两者都是「—」。
brief.en: Bytes come down the wire back to back from the first tick, each followed by a parity bit (making the count of 1s in the nine even), and the wire flips bits. On the tick each parity bit arrives, output the byte received and say whether its parity checks out; 「—」 on both at every other tick.

t.zh: 从这里起，线会把个别的位翻过来。收到的字节错了，收的一方却毫不知情，照样把它交出去。两头于是约好一条规则：发送方在数据后面附一位，收的一方按同一规则核对，就知道数据在线上有没有被改。
t.en: From here on, the wire flips the odd bit. A byte arrives wrong and the receiver hands it on without knowing. So the ends agree on a rule: the sender appends a bit after the data, and the receiver checks it by the same rule to tell whether the data changed on the way.

brief.zh: 线上连续送来位；每当到这一拍为止最近 8 位是 01111110，就在那一拍输出 1，其余各拍输出 0。
brief.en: Bits keep coming down the wire; output 1 on every tick at which the last 8 bits read 01111110, and 0 on every other.

t.zh: 起始位分得出一个个字节，却分不出哪几个字节是一帧：一帧有几个字节，事先并不知道。于是两头约好一个记号 01111110，叫旗标，用它标出一帧的开头和结尾。收的一方要在不停到来的位里随时认出它。
t.en: Start bits separate single bytes but not frames: how many bytes a frame holds is not known in advance. So the ends agree on a mark, 01111110, the flag, to show where a frame begins and ends. The receiver must spot it at any point in the stream of bits.

brief.zh: 把交来的字节依次送出，每个字节前加起始位 1，后加停止位 0；字节送完以后线上一直是 0。说「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节，下一拍换上后一个。
brief.en: Send the bytes handed to you one after another, each with a start bit 1 before it and a stop bit 0 after; once they are all sent the wire stays 0. Saying next takes the byte in front of you that tick, and the following one shows the tick after.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-9"></level-ref>收的是这样的字节，现在轮到发送一方。要送的字节排成一队，一次只看得见排在最前面的那一个；队伍空了，看到的是「—」。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-9"></level-ref> received bytes like these; now it is the sender's turn. The bytes to send wait in a queue, and only the one in front can be seen; once the queue is empty, it shows 「—」.

brief.zh: 对方随时可能先说一个 1，再送 8 位，最后说一个 0；每收到一个字节，就在它最后一位到达的那一拍输出它，其余各拍输出「—」。
brief.en: At any tick the far end may say a 1, then 8 bits, then a 0; output each byte on the tick its last bit arrives, and 「—」 on every other tick.

t.zh: 发送方随时可能开口，而空着的线读出来是 0：一个以 0 开头的字节和安静的线分不出来，收的一方不知道从哪一拍数起。于是两头约好：字节之前先说一个 1，叫起始位；字节之后说一个 0，叫停止位。
t.en: The sender may begin at any tick, and an idle wire reads 0: a byte that begins with 0s looks just like a quiet wire, and the receiver cannot tell where to start counting. So the ends agree: before a byte comes a 1, the start bit, and after it a 0, the stop bit.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起（还没为 1 过时从第一拍起），线上连续送来 8 位，最高位在前；收满 8 位的那一拍输出这个字节。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1 (from the first tick, before it ever is), eight bits come down the wire, top bit first; output the byte on the tick the eighth arrives.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-7"></level-ref>把一个字节拆成位送出去；线的另一头要把位拼回一个数。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-7"></level-ref> takes a byte apart into bits; the other end of the wire has to put the bits back into a number.

desc.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起（还没为 1 过时从第一拍起）逐拍收进位，最高位在前；收满 8 位的那一拍给出这个字节，其余各拍给「—」。
desc.en: From the tick start is 1 (from the first tick, before it ever is) takes in a bit a tick, top bit first; gives the byte on the tick the eighth arrives and 「—」 on every other.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，用 8 拍把那一拍输入的字节从最高位起逐位说到线上，之后说 0；最后一位说出的那一拍，「送完」为 1，其余各拍为 0。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1, say the byte input on that tick on the wire bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, then say 0; done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said and 0 on every other.

t.zh: 要送过去的是 0 到 255 的数，线一拍却只送一位。一个字节是 8 位二进制数，每一位的分量是后一位的两倍。新元件<part-ref to="part:bit"></part-ref>从一个数里取出指定的一位，<part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref>说两个数是否相同。
t.en: What must go across is a number from 0 to 255, but the wire carries one bit a tick. A byte is an 8-bit binary number, each place worth twice the next. The new part <part-ref to="part:bit"></part-ref> takes one given bit out of a number, and <part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref> says whether two numbers are the same.

desc.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，用 8 拍把那一拍的字节从最高位起逐位说出，之后说「—」（线上是 0）；说出最后一位的那一拍「送完」为 1。「开始」再为 1 时重新送。
desc.en: From the tick start is 1, says the byte of that tick bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, then 「—」 (0 on a wire); done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said. Start again sends anew.

brief.zh: 输出自「重来」上一次为 1 起已经过了几拍（那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时，从第一拍数起）。
brief.en: Output how many ticks have passed since restart was last 1 (0 on that tick; counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1).

t.zh: 要知道一个字节该发到第几位、已经收了几位，板得知道过了几拍；寄存卡只记一个值，手上的元件又都不能让一个数变大。新元件<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>给出两个数之和。
t.en: To know which bit of a byte is due, or how many have come in, a board must know how many ticks have passed; a register holds one value, and nothing in hand makes a number grow. The new part <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref> gives the sum of two numbers.

desc.zh: 自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍：那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时从第一拍数起。
desc.en: How many ticks since restart was last 1: 0 on that tick; counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1.

why: The flags branch finished: the framer (1-12) and the deframer (1-13); start bits, flags and checks as three parallel branches after the byte

brief.zh: 把交来的字节一帧一帧地送出：每帧前后各加旗标 01111110，内容里每连着 5 个 1 就多说一个 0。一帧只在「发送」为 1 的拍开始，两帧之间线上是 0。「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节，「末字节」说明它是不是这一帧的最后一个。
brief.en: Send the bytes handed to you frame by frame: the flag 01111110 at each end of a frame, and a 0 added after every five 1s in its content. A frame begins only on a tick send is 1, and the wire is 0 between frames. Saying next takes the byte in front of you; last says whether it ends its frame.

t.zh: 旗标标出一帧从哪开始、到哪结束。可一帧的内容本身也可能含有 01111110：收的一方会把它当成旗标，一帧被从中间切断。于是两头再约好一条：内容里每连着 5 个 1，发送方就多说一个 0，收的一方再把它去掉，内容里就永远不会出现旗标。
t.en: Flags mark where a frame begins and ends. But a frame's content may itself hold 01111110: the receiver takes it for a flag and the frame is cut in two. So the ends agree on one more rule: after every five 1s in a row in the content, the sender says an extra 0, and the receiver takes it out again, so the content never looks like a flag.

desc.zh: 把交来的字节一帧一帧地送出：「发送」为 1 的拍开始一帧，前后各加旗标 01111110，内容里每连着 5 个 1 多说一个 0；两帧之间线上是 0。「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节。
desc.en: Sends the bytes handed to it frame by frame: a frame begins on a tick send is 1, with the flag 01111110 at each end and a 0 added after every five 1s in its content; the wire is 0 between frames. Next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it.

brief.zh: 从线上认出旗标之间的每一帧，去掉塞进的 0，逐个给出内容字节：一个字节收全的那一拍，「字节」给出它，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍，「帧尾」为 1。其余各拍「字节」是「—」，「收到」和「帧尾」为 0。
brief.en: Find each frame between flags on the wire, take out the stuffed 0s and give the content bytes one by one: on the tick a byte is complete, output it and make got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, make end 1. On every other tick the byte is 「—」 and got and end are 0.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-12"></level-ref>送出的帧到了线的另一头：收的一方要认出旗标，把塞进的 0 去掉，再把位拼回字节。
t.en: Frames like those of <level-ref to="1-12"></level-ref> reach the other end of the wire: the receiver has to spot the flags, take out the stuffed 0s and put the bits back into bytes.

desc.zh: 在进线的位流里认出旗标之间的每一帧，去掉塞进的 0：一个内容字节收全的那一拍给出它，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1；其余各拍字节是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
desc.en: Finds each frame between flags in the bits on its wire in and takes out the stuffed 0s: gives each content byte on the tick it is complete, with got 1, and makes end 1 on the tick the closing flag is complete; on every other tick the byte is 「—」 and got and end are 0.

brief.zh: 线会翻位。每帧的内容后面跟一个校验字节（5 个 0，再加整帧内容的 3 位校验码），和内容一起做位填充。逐个给出每帧的内容字节，每个字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍给出，同时「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「完好」说出这一帧是否完好。其余各拍「字节」「完好」是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
brief.en: The wire flips bits. Each frame's content is followed by a check byte (five 0s, then the 3 check bits of the whole content), stuffed along with it. Give each frame's content bytes one by one, each on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1 on that tick; on the tick the closing flag is complete make end 1 and say in intact whether the frame arrived intact. On every other tick the byte and intact are 「—」, got and end 0.

t.zh: 到这里为止，校验码护着的只是一个字节。一帧有几个字节事先不知道，校验码于是放在整帧的内容后面，补成一个整字节：收的一方要等这一帧收完，才知道哪个字节是校验字节。
t.en: So far a check has guarded a single byte. A frame's length is not known in advance, so its check goes after the whole content, padded to a whole byte: the receiver only knows which byte is the check once the frame is over.

desc.zh: 从进线上拆出每一帧，扣下最后的校验字节：每个内容字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「完好」说出这一帧是否完好。其余各拍字节和「完好」是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
desc.en: Unwraps each frame off its wire in and holds back the closing check byte: gives each content byte on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and intact says whether the frame arrived intact. On every other tick the byte and intact are 「—」, got and end 0.

brief.zh: 搭一块网卡，两个方向同时在走。往下：交来的帧带上校验字节，成帧送到出线上；一帧只在「发送」为 1 的拍开始，「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节。往上：进线上来的帧拆开、核对，每个内容字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍交给上面，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「完好」说出这一帧是否完好。其余各拍「字节」「完好」是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
brief.en: Build a network card, with both directions running at once. Down: frames handed to it go out on the wire out, framed with their check byte; a frame begins only on a tick send is 1, and saying next takes the byte in front of you. Up: frames off the wire in are unwrapped and checked, each content byte going up on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and intact says whether the frame arrived intact. On every other tick the byte and intact are 「—」, got and end 0.

t.zh: 发帧、收帧、查错分在几块板上，每一个要用线的节点都得把它们重新接一遍。把它们装进一块网卡：对上面只收发整帧的字节，对下面只收发线上的位，上面不必知道旗标、填充和校验字节。这叫分层。
t.en: Sending frames, receiving them and checking them sit on separate boards, and every node that uses a wire would have to wire them up again. Put them in one network card: it deals in the bytes of whole frames with the layer above and in bits on the wire below, and the layer above never sees flags, stuffing or the check byte. This is layering.

desc.zh: 往下：交来的帧带上校验字节成帧送到出线上，「发送」为 1 的拍开始一帧，「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节。往上：进线上来的帧拆开、核对，每个内容字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「完好」说出这一帧是否完好。
desc.en: Down: frames handed to it go out on its wire out, framed with their check byte; a frame begins on a tick send is 1, and next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it. Up: frames off its wire in are unwrapped and checked, each content byte given on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and intact says whether the frame arrived intact.

brief.zh: 在两根线之间转发：左边进线上来的帧，一个字节一个字节地交给右边的网卡，从右边的出线送出去，不等整帧收完。左边到时是坏的帧，从右边出去也不能是完好的。
brief.en: Forward between two wires: pass each frame from the left wire in on to a card for the right-hand wire out, byte by byte, without waiting for the whole frame. A frame that arrived broken on the left must not leave intact on the right.

t.zh: 一根线只连着两头。要让帧走得更远，中间的节点得把一根线上收到的帧，转到另一根线上去。
t.en: A wire joins only two ends. For a frame to travel further, a node in the middle has to pass what it receives on one wire on to another.
